instruction: Create one Part Design body. Create a circular base disk centered at the origin with radius 22 mm, height 4 mm, and axis along global Z, spanning Z = 0 to 4. Add a central cylindrical hub, meaning a raised cylinder at the center of the disk, with radius 8 mm, height 8 mm, axis along global Z, spanning Z = 4 to 12. Add one cylindrical boss, meaning a smaller raised cylinder on top of the base disk, with radius 4 mm, height 6 mm, axis along global Z, centered at (14, 0) and spanning Z = 4 to 10. Use Part Design Polar Pattern around the global Z axis through the origin to make 6 total boss occurrences evenly spaced through 360 degrees, so the boss centers lie on a 14 mm radius circle at 60 degree intervals. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
